items.title: Pocket Egg
items.hint: The Cucco Lady in Kakariko hands you a pocket egg. Wait a while (play the Sun's Song a few times) and it hatches.

items.title: Pocket Cucco → wake Talon
items.hint: Use the hatched cucco to wake Talon, asleep in a house in Kakariko. He stumbles home — and leaves his blue cucco, Cojiro, behind.

items.title: Cojiro → man in the Lost Woods
items.hint: Carry Cojiro to the man in the Lost Woods who lost his cucco. He takes it back and hands you a strange mushroom.

items.title: Odd Mushroom → Granny (TIMED)
items.hint: Take the mushroom to Granny in the Kakariko Potion Shop. Hurry — it spoils fast, so go straight there. She brews it into a potion.

items.title: Odd Potion → man in the Lost Woods
items.hint: Carry the finished potion back to the man in the Lost Woods. He is grateful and gives you a poacher's saw.

items.title: Poacher's Saw → head carpenter
items.hint: Give the saw to the boss carpenter in Gerudo Valley. In return he hands over a broken Goron sword.

items.title: Broken Goron's Sword → Biggoron
items.hint: Climb to the summit and show the broken sword to Biggoron, the giant Goron. He agrees to reforge it and gives you a prescription for his sore eyes.

items.title: Prescription → King Zora
items.hint: Deliver the prescription to King Zora. He gives you an eyeball frog to take to the lake scientist.

items.title: Eyeball Frog → Lake Scientist (TIMED)
items.hint: Rush the frog to the scientist at the Lakeside Laboratory before it spoils. He uses it to make the world's finest eye drops.

items.title: Eye Drops → Biggoron
items.hint: Bring the eye drops back up the mountain to Biggoron. His eyes clear up — he gives you a claim check for the finished sword.

items.title: Claim Check → Biggoron's Sword
items.hint: The sword takes three days to forge. Play the Sun's Song six times to pass the time, then return with the claim check to collect Biggoron's Sword.
